name: 08050 · Manahawkin, NJ
findings: ZIP 08050 (Manahawkin) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08050 (Manahawkin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08050 (Manahawkin) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
